subject.title: Feature: pairing list-approved and pairing revoke commands

question: Should OpenClaw add narrow terminal pairing-management commands now, fold this into the broader paired-contact inventory work, or keep pairing management limited to existing `/allowlist` and manual/doctor paths?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested commands expose and mutate sender authorization state and overlap an open broader contact/permissions issue plus existing in-chat allowlist controls.

options.title: Fold into contact management
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48620 as the canonical product surface and design CLI/status behavior there.

options.title: Approve narrow pairing CLI
options.body: Add account-scoped `pairing list-approved` and `pairing revoke` with explicit redaction, JSON output, tests, and docs while leaving broader contact inventory separate.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces only
options.body: Decline new terminal commands and document `/allowlist list/remove --store` plus doctor guidance as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Fold into contact management
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48620 as the canonical product surface and design CLI/status behavior there.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping `/allowlist` and pairing CLI history points to this owner as the best available product-boundary decision route.
